title: Bài mẫu: Jet lag
raw:
0:00 Hi Tom, you look exhausted. Late night?
0:03 Not really, I just can't seem to shake off this jet lag.
0:07 Where did you fly back from?
0:09 Lisbon. Only a two-hour difference, but my body refuses to adjust.
0:14 Two hours shouldn't knock you out like that.
0:17 You'd think so. I woke up at four this morning and couldn't drift off again.
0:22 Have you tried getting some daylight as soon as you wake up?
0:26 Daylight? Honestly, I just reach for a coffee.
0:29 That's the problem. Caffeine on an empty stomach makes the crash even worse.
0:34 So what do you suggest, a brisk walk at dawn?
0:37 Exactly. Ten minutes outside resets your internal clock faster than anything.
0:42 Fine, I'll give it a go tomorrow. Any other tips?
0:45 Skip the afternoon nap, however tempting it feels.
0:49 That's going to be a struggle. My sofa is very persuasive.
0:53 Then put your phone on the other side of the room and go for the walk instead.
0:58 Deal. Remind me of this conversation when I'm grumpy at three o'clock.
